scenicChapters.title: Slovenia Vrsic Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1611 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
